podcast.body: This "glammy stomper" was the lead single from the 1974 'Diamond Dogs' album. While it only reached number 64 on the Hot 100, it quickly became a favorite on AOR (Album Oriented Rock) radio, and it's suggested it would have been a rock smash if Billboard had an album rock chart in 1974. "The Diamond Dogs album was led by one of Boey's catchiest singles, The Glammy Stomper Rebel Rebel. It only reached number 64 on the Hot 100, but quickly emerged as a favorite on AOR radio."
